target: Adjusted dissolved oxygen at observed nitrate/water-mass state
timing: Contemporaneous adjusted oxygen diagnostic using independently instrumented nitrate and CTD measurements from the same aligned synthetic profile. No prospective acquisition claim. Adjusted T/S flags1,2,8 permit source interpolation; oxygen/nitrate/pressure flags1,2 only.
groups: Whole float profiles; rolling half-year tests 2023H2,2024H1,H2,2025H1, earlier times train. July2025 onward reserved. Two serially sampled floats, not hundreds of independent oceans.
eligibility: Deterministic native.py finite, timing and quality rules; no outcome-performance filtering.
primary_metric: Arithmetic mean of within-group MAE in target units; original observations retained.
baselines: Strong simple/persistence/domain baseline and constrained radial-basis flexible control under identical permitted inputs.
selection: Minimum whole-group development MAE; within1% choose lower coefficient complexity, then lexicographic model identity. Baselines may win.
stopping: At least5 distinct substantive attempts. Continue if distinct justified hypothesis remains and recent attempts improve development prediction, robustness or supported interpretation. Stop after2 consecutive substantive attempts without incumbent MAE/robustness/interpretation gain.
uncertainty: Report whole-group errors and ranges; no independent-row population CI. Temporal/spatial dependence and small number of sites/floats limit inference.
exposure: Inspected dimensions, parameter names/QC inventories and dates only, no numerical oxygen values. All public source-aware; confirmation after final freeze will become exposed.
